title: Vulnerability digest — 24 Nov 2026, 20:05 CET
markdown:
* **CVE-2026-131914**, Idunno AntiCsrf: Unauthenticated remote attackers can execute arbitrary code via object injection due to a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability, and users are advised to discontinue use or transition to a supported version since the product may be end-of-life/end-of-service. [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-131914), [Mandiant](https://github.com/mandiant/Vulnerability-Disclosures/blob/master/2026/MNDT-2026-0048.md), [CISA Directive](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk)
* **CVE-2026-132224**, Optimizely Web Experimentation: An external control of critical state data vulnerability in the account signup flow allows an attacker to impersonate existing users, modify Project JavaScript, and distribute attacker-controlled code to browsers visiting affected customer sites. [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-132224), [Optimizely Incident Report](https://pages.optimizely.com/rs/947-RKE-048/images/Security%20Incident%20Report%20-%20Optimizely%20Web%20Experimentation%20-%20Nov%2017%202026.pdf), [Optimizely Status](https://status.optimizely.com/incidents/ftw0fh9wx43z)
* **CVE-2026-132165**, Drupal Core: Unauthenticated attackers can take over existing sites or execute arbitrary code under specific conditions via the installer by attempting to reinstall Drupal. [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-132165), [Drupal Advisory](https://www.drupal.org/sa-core-2026-017), [CISA Directive](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk)
* **CVE-2026-109484**, Microsoft Azure App Service for Linux: Unauthorized attackers can elevate privileges over a network due to a special element injection vulnerability. [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-109484), [Microsoft Update Guide](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-109484)

items.title: Idunno AntiCsrf Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
items.match_text:
Idunno AntiCsrf Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.
Idunno AntiCsrf

items.title: Optimizely Web Experimentation External Control of Critical State Data Vulnerability
items.match_text:
Optimizely Web Experimentation External Control of Critical State Data Vulnerability
Optimizely Web Experimentation contains an external control of critical state data vulnerability in its account signup flow that could allow an attacker to impersonate existing customer users and modify Project JavaScript. Successful exploitation can result in attacker-controlled JavaScript being distributed through Optimizely-hosted assets and executed in browsers visiting affected customer websites.
Optimizely Web Experimentation

items.title: Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
items.match_text:
Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site.
Drupal Core
